_meta.indication: ELREXFIO is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma who have received at least four prior lines of therapy, including a proteasome inhibitor, an immunomodulatory agent, and an anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody.

pivotal_trials.design: Single-arm, multicenter, multicohort trial of elranatamab monotherapy; enrolled two independent parallel cohorts (Cohort A naive to BCMA-directed therapy; Cohort B with prior BCMA-directed therapy).
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma refractory to at least one PI, one IMiD, and one anti-CD38 mAb; the primary efficacy population was 97 Cohort A patients with at least 4 prior lines of therapy including a PI, an IMiD, and an anti-CD38 mAb.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Objective response rate (ORR) supported by duration of response (DOR), per BICR by IMWG criteria.
pivotal_trials.n: Primary efficacy population N=97 (Cohort A); primary safety population N=183.
pivotal_trials.result: ORR in the efficacy population was 57.7% (95% CI: 47.3%, 67.7%); median DOR not reached, with DOR rate 90.4% at 6 months and 82.3% at 9 months.

key_safety: Cytokine release syndrome (58%) and neurologic toxicity (59%) were the key concerns; other common adverse reactions (>=20%) included fatigue (43%), injection site reaction (37%), diarrhea (36%), pyrexia (21%), and nausea (22%). Serious adverse events occurred in 68% of patients.
target_moa: Elranatamab is a bispecific BCMA-directed and CD3-directed T-cell engaging antibody; it binds BCMA on multiple myeloma cells and CD3 on T-cells, activating T-cells to release cytokines and lyse BCMA-expressing myeloma cells.
modality: bispecific (BCMA-directed CD3 T-cell engaging bispecific antibody)

boxed_warning.content: Boxed warning for Cytokine Release Syndrome (CRS), including life-threatening or fatal reactions, and Neurologic Toxicity, including Immune Effector Cell-Associated Neurotoxicity Syndrome (ICANS); ELREXFIO is available only through a restricted REMS program.

rems.type: ELREXFIO is available only through a restricted program under a REMS called the ELREXFIO REMS because of the risks of CRS and neurologic toxicity, including ICANS. Prescribers, pharmacies, and healthcare settings must be certified with the program.

advisory_committee.vote: The application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because it did not raise significant public health questions on the role of the biologic in the diagnosis, cure, mitigation, treatment, or prevention of a disease.

confirmatory_requirement.text: A required randomized clinical trial (PMR 4476-1) in RRMM comparing an elranatamab-based regimen to standard therapy, with primary endpoint progression-free survival, to verify and describe clinical benefit; the proposed confirmatory trial is the ongoing MagnetisMM-5 (C1071005).

citations.quote: 4476-1 Complete a randomized clinical trial in patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. Patients should be randomized to receive an elranatamab-based regimen compared to standard therapy for relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. The primary endpoint should be progression-free survival and secondary endpoints should include overall survival and overall response rate.
